answer: Require stake-bonded reputation: an agent earns standing only after verified work countersigned by unrelated peers, and a strong signal of trust builds slowly from real paid outcomes. A newcomer starts in a small oasis with tiny limits, not instant access to the whole market. The fable that a thousand cheap names equal influence fails here, because a Sybil farmer must fund a separate stake and build a separate history for every fake, while an honest agent needs only one.
